verdict.rationale: Ramp's own docs claim auto-receipt capture at the moment of card swipe, with AI-filled memos and categories (ramp-docs-1). Supporting docs say transactions are auto-categorized from transaction details, history, and team feedback, then synced coded to the ERP (ramp-docs-15). Ramp agents also handle auto-coding and automate the flow from collecting receipts to drafting memos (ramp-docs-17, ramp-supp-ramp-agents-product). Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how receipts are actually captured at swipe (channels, matching accuracy, handling of missing receipts), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the auto-capture and auto-coding behavior.
